nodes.name: rotowire_injuries.R
nodes.summary: Exports rotowire_injuries(), which pulls the current NBA injury report from RotoWire's public JSON feed and returns a tidy tibble of player injury statuses.

nodes.name: salary_draft_utils.R
nodes.summary: Internal shared HTML-scraping helpers (ext_html, parse_currency, next_data) used by the HoopsHype salaries, Spotrac team-cap, and NBADraft.net mock-draft wrappers; all sources are public HTML requiring no API key.

nodes.name: spotrac_team_cap.R
nodes.summary: Exports spotrac_team_cap(), scraping Spotrac's public team salary-cap pages into a tibble of per-team cap and contract figures.

nodes.name: torvik_game_schedule.R
nodes.summary: Exports torvik_game_schedule(), retrieving Bart Torvik's men's college basketball game schedule data as a tidy tibble.

nodes.name: torvik_game_stats.R
nodes.summary: Exports torvik_game_stats(), fetching per-game advanced statistics from barttorvik.com for men's college basketball games.

nodes.name: torvik_ncaa_results.R
nodes.summary: Exports torvik_ncaa_results(), scraping Bart Torvik's historical NCAA tournament results tables into a tidy tibble.

nodes.name: torvik_player_stats.R
nodes.summary: Exports torvik_player_stats(), pulling Bart Torvik player-level season statistics for men's college basketball.

nodes.name: torvik_ratings.R
nodes.summary: Exports torvik_ratings(), retrieving Bart Torvik's team efficiency ratings for men's college basketball as a tibble.

nodes.name: torvik_team_factors.R
nodes.summary: Exports torvik_team_factors(), fetching Bart Torvik four-factors and tempo-free team metrics for men's college basketball.

nodes.name: torvik_utils.R
nodes.summary: Internal shared HTTP layer (torvik_text) for the family of torvik_*() scrapers, centralizing requests to barttorvik.com which needs no account or API key.

nodes.name: utils_nba_stats.R
nodes.summary: Internal HTTP and result-parsing layer for the NBA Stats / G-League APIs: builds endpoint requests (with proxy support), maps stats.nba.com resultSets into tibbles, and provides id/time padding plus schedule-rejoin helpers.

nodes.name: utils.R
nodes.summary: Package-wide utility module: KenPom login/credential handling, cached CSV/RDS loaders from URLs, season/year helpers (most_recent_mbb_season, year_to_season), team-name normalization, progress messaging, and the hoopR_data S3 class with its print method.

nodes.name: README.Rmd
nodes.summary: Source R Markdown for the package README rendered to README.md, covering hoopR's purpose, installation, quick-start usage, and documentation links.

nodes.name: cbbd-college-basketball-data.Rmd
nodes.summary: Vignette documenting the CollegeBasketballData (CBD/CBBD) endpoints in hoopR, including API-key registration and worked examples for conferences, teams, venues, and other reference data.

nodes.name: espn-endpoints.Rmd
nodes.summary: Comprehensive vignette walking through hoopR's ESPN NBA and MBB endpoint surface, organized by use case with worked examples (news, scores, schedules, rosters, and more).

nodes.name: getting-started-hoopR.Rmd
nodes.summary: Getting-started vignette covering hoopR installation, a quick-start example, and credits to authors and contributors.

nodes.name: kenpom-example-functions.Rmd
nodes.summary: Vignette demonstrating the KenPom (kp_*) ratings, team, and historical table functions in hoopR with example calls.

nodes.name: mbb-cookbook.Rmd
nodes.summary: Recipe-style men's college basketball cookbook vignette stitching together hoopR loaders (schedule, PBP, KenPom tempo-free metrics) into end-to-end analysis workflows.

nodes.name: nba-cookbook.Rmd
nodes.summary: Recipe-style NBA cookbook vignette showing how to combine hoopR's ESPN and NBA Stats loaders at different levels of detail (game summary, box scores, play-by-play) into worked analysis examples.
